mean_layout.population: all 57 non-full-retention mean instances among the original 960; 903 full-retention instances remain automatic-exclusion controls
mean_layout.cyclic: sort contribution ascending stably within each original selected row, then rotate by original row index modulo T
mean_layout.random: independent per-row permutation from fixed PCG64 seed; same deterministic seed per instance
mean_layout.interpretation: posthoc synthetic mechanism intervention, not new evaluator panels or new independent NLP data
mean_layout.oracle: all column subsets; all tied separately minimal safety/exclusion witnesses

scenario_risk.risk: all committed membership flips for each of the MT replacements divided by 2k
scenario_risk.means: equal per-mask averages; overlapping splits descriptive
scenario_risk.source: original saved masks; no changed acquisition
